_comment: Complete Lite and Standard tier pricing by country/currency from Google Play Store. Reference only — actual pricing is managed in App Store Connect and Google Play Console. The app displays currency code inferred from timezone and lets the store handle localized pricing.
note: All pricing data as of July 2026. Store handles VAT calculation automatically by country.

pricing_strategy.currency_display: App shows user's inferred currency code (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP') based on timezone
pricing_strategy.actual_pricing: Google Play Store / App Store Connect handles all country-specific pricing and VAT
pricing_strategy.app_responsibility: Display currency code for context only — don't hardcode per-country prices
pricing_strategy.store_responsibility: Convert USD base prices to local currency, apply VAT, handle checkout
pricing_strategy.example_workflow: 1) User in UK logs in → 2) Server infers GBP from timezone → 3) App displays 'GBP' → 4) User taps Subscribe → 5) Store shows actual GBP price (£53.99 annual Lite, etc.) → 6) User pays in local currency with VAT

key_pricing_points.lite_tier_reduction: Reduced from $7.99 to $5.99/month (25% lower entry barrier)
key_pricing_points.conversion_expected: 15-25% uplift from currency localization; 30-40% uplift from price reduction

note_for_developers: Don't build dynamic pricing lookup. Let the platform stores handle it. Your job is to display the inferred currency and route users to the store for checkout. The store takes care of the rest.
